name: com.grafomem/cgr-capture
title: GRAFOMEM CGR Capture
description: Record agent judgments and their real outcomes on GRAFOMEM Cloud. Capture now, score later.

environmentVariables.name: GRAFOMEM_CGR_TENANT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your GRAFOMEM Cloud tenant API key (X-API-Key). Needs decisions:read for the durability guard.

environmentVariables.name: GRAFOMEM_CGR_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: The tenant id you expect that key to resolve to. If the key resolves to any other tenant, every write is refused.

environmentVariables.name: GRAFOMEM_CGR_ROLE_KEYS_JSON
environmentVariables.description: Role handles to public agent_key (64-hex Ed25519), inline as JSON. Example: {"cc-builder@acme":"<64-hex>"}. Use this or GRAFOMEM_CGR_ROLE_KEYS.

environmentVariables.name: GRAFOMEM_CGR_ROLE_KEYS
environmentVariables.description: Path to a JSON file with the same role-handle to public agent_key mapping. Use this or GRAFOMEM_CGR_ROLE_KEYS_JSON.

environmentVariables.name: GRAFOMEM_CGR_FORBIDDEN_TENANTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tenant ids to always refuse, even if pinned by mistake. Put your production tenant here.

environmentVariables.name: GRAFOMEM_API
environmentVariables.description: GRAFOMEM Cloud base URL. Defaults to https://api.grafomem.com.
